scope: Sanitized metadata only. Existing receipts and source-binding preparation; no raw code, private oracle, machine path, or new model request.

api_previous_attempt.reason: Owner state file changed during repeated admission checks.
api_previous_attempt.disposition: Original failed receipt retained; no class family or compiler-failure credit. A separate immutable carrier later obtained the actual first.

parent_review_scope: Whole source-ready and literal recipe read; independent inverse, recorded plan equality, existing immutable receipt and output hashes. Final full helper review and execution belong to the execution owner.

parent_preparation_error.category: Shell argument quoting in a parent-only metadata check
parent_preparation_error.effect: Syntax error before metadata body; no candidate helper or JVM.
parent_preparation_error.correction: Same metadata through stdin; independently recorded.

cost_boundary: Compiler, managed wrapper, and source preparation windows are separate scopes and must not be added as independent elapsed totals. No active-time estimate.
